notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are currently working on a new update.
First and foremost, we are creating the final battle against Hessler that many have asked for and that our beloved antagonist deserves.
On the other hand, we continue to fix small bugs that remained and adjust the patterns of both shots and enemies for all difficulty levels.
Thanks to all who supported us by purchasing the game.
Over and out!

notes.title: Game development log #2 : THE STORY
notes.content:
Welcome to another chapter on our dev log!
This time we will be talking about the story and the characters.

Historically most Shoot em’ up games don’t have a story, its roots are in the arcade, and on arcades you don’t have time to spend on a game story. In the best cases, you were awarded with a still image and a little text at the end.
Today, thankfully we can play at our homes without someone waiting in line for us to finish our game, and that gives the developers the opportunity to include a story to give some sense to what you are doing.
Is that good? Bad? Depends on the player, but we like some introduction to the world and a little story to get involved in the game.


[h2][b]The story[/b][/h2]
[b]Rising Sun[/b] takes place around 1947 in a fictionary ww2 post war. The idea was to take some real life events and make it part of the story.
The game puts you in the skin of four different pilots before and after being in the Valkyrias squadron following the path of Albert Hessler to stop his plans.
In your journey you will confront all of Hessler’s commanders to stop them, and in the process learn the truth and their real motives.

[b]As a resume:[/b]

We have [i]Albert Hessler[/i] an ex-commander now aimed at gather ex combatants to create the mercenary unit “skulls”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/ddd5be61cef01770185d3e0daca65e543115bcd9.png[/img]

In response to this, the United Nations, trough the SDU (Special Defense Unit), creates the valkyrias to fight Skulls

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/f7771a393dfde5c3714bacee99af9227fd414d85.png[/img]

The valkyias are a squad made up of elite pilots, Commanded by [i]Anna Baudin[/i]. A french pilot.

[h2][b]The Characters[/b][/h2]
For most of the characters we took some real life people for reference, actors, friends… but always having in mind that we want that the aesthetics also reflect the way of behaving and make simpler what it represents for the player. 

[h3][b]The Valkyria squadron[/b][/h3]
The valkyries were divine entities that served odin.
Their purpose was to choose the most heroic of those fallen in battle and take them to Valhalla.
With that in mind, we wanted to represent that idea with these characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/e935f2af1d486428c3727e41b068e16059489b79.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Skull squadron[/b][/h3]
Hessler and his commanders.
Each of them is in charge of a different branch of their army, air, sea, land and weapons development.
All of them are connected on way or another with the valkyria squadron and the story between them will unfold as you progress through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/a11c48d4fc4a9c4025e1834f56bc652a773607b5.png[/img]

Hope you enjoyed this small story introduction!

Next time we will be covering some gameplay with the game system.

See you soon pilots!

MoebiusOne Team

notes.title: Game development log #1 : GAME MODES
notes.content:
Welcome to the first "Dev Log" post.
Considering we are near the release date (february) we will be showing some game features you are going to get in the game.

The game has two main modes; [b]ARCADE[/b] and [b]STORY[/b] mode.
Both modes can be played solo or cooperative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/76b1a77e5be9574474617b8b510dec496fe2d32a.png[/img]

[h2][b]STORY MODE[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Introduction Story[/b][/h3]

There are four introductory levels. Each of them is intended to give a framework to each of the characters, and the possibility to learn about their past before being part of the Valkyries.
These levels introduce two different gameplay modes apart from the traditional shoot em' up gameplay: Attack and Dogfight Modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/da11ed22526db5eb29a399825ec521c092f4ac9d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Valkyria Story[/b][/h3]

After the introduction level this is where the valkyrias story begins, 7 levels where you can upgrade, unlock new fighters and skins.
Earn money to buy new weapons and buy the possibility to ease your progress.
Unlocking and maxing fighters in story mode allows you to use them in Arcade mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/6f32d264a7f0d67e8b1ecc6e98c208d86c2b322e.png[/img]

[h2][b]ARCADE MODE[/b][/h2]

The objective of the arcade mode is simple… 
Avoid being killed and score points to earn a top place on the leaderboards.
Unlimited continues that affects your score and leaderboards depending on your ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457755/41728b2ba156a78aadfaad912a50792fc745b36f.png[/img]

If you are interested in more information, ask for it!

Next Dev Log we will be talking about the game story.

“See you soon pilots!”

MoebiusOne Team
